acceptedAnswer.text: Welding management software digitizes a fabrication shop's welding records — welder qualifications (WPS, PQR, WPQ), weld tracking and mapping, procedure control and inspection history — so every joint is traceable and audit-ready. Elenchon does this entirely on-premise, keeping the full weld record on hardware you own.

Elenchon is a 100% on-premise appliance installed in your facility — the sovereign alternative to cloud welding software. Your manufacturing data never touches a shared server, there are no forced updates, and you don't depend on a vendor's cloud to reach your own records.

mainEntity.name: Does Elenchon manage welder qualification (WPS, PQR, WPQ)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Elenchon runs the full WPS/PQR/WPQ qualification workflow with live WPQ capture, automatic 6-month welder continuity tracking and expiry alerts — so you never miss a requalification or weld outside an approved range.

mainEntity.name: How does it help with ISO 3834 and ASME IX compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elenchon turns shop-floor activity into immutable, version-pinned compliance ledgers. Every qualification, variable and process is verified and locked the moment it is captured, so audit evidence for codes such as ISO 3834 and ASME IX is instant and undisputed.

mainEntity.name: Can we access an on-premise system remotely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through Phrakton, our zero-trust network overlay. Authorised staff and auditors connect over mutually authenticated, post-quantum-safe tunnels, while the appliance opens no inbound ports and stays invisible to the public internet.

Pricing is published in the open: a flat monthly rate per appliance — Lite from €390/month with 20 workers included, Standard from €790/month with 50 — plus extra seats at a low €9/month, every add-on listed in plain euros, and no lock-in. See the pricing page for the full breakdown.
